name: SeedVR2 3B / 7B (numz safetensors repack)
usage: Upscaling and restoration of real-world degradations, one step, no prompt

sources.note: Repo 60.1 GB; the 3B fp16 (6.78), 7B fp16 (16.48) and VAE (0.5) files make ≈ 23.8 GB; the repo mflux uses
For ComfyUI's native node, 113 GB in all

size_gb.note: 3B fp16, 7B fp16 and VAE files only (the repository holds more)

runtimes.value: mflux (mflux-upscale-seedvr2, MLX, native on the Mac); ComfyUI native node; numz custom node buggy on MPS

provenance.value: consistent: the fp16 files are exactly half of ByteDance's fp32 .pth files (7B 16.48 / 32.96 GB, 3B 6.78 / 13.57 GB, VAE 0.50 / 1.00 GB, differences of a few tens of kB = pickle overhead); no conversion script or hash published
provenance.note: maintained by the authors of the ComfyUI-SeedVR2 node (about 3,000 GitHub stars); base_model ByteDance-Seed/SeedVR2-3B and -7B; about 789,000 downloads; the card says Apache 2.0 at the top and MIT for the code at the end

web.verdict: Community default upscaler; prefer mflux on the Mac
web.summary: Presented by mflux as the best upscaling model. On an M5 Max 128 GB the numz ComfyUI node hit five MPS bugs (fixes supplied); a ComfyUI update broke it in 11.2026 and the maintainer points to the native node. Video upscaling is memory-hungry.
web.scope: Released 06.2025 (more than 12 months): comments since 13.05.2026. Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, GitHub issues; Reddit blocked.

comments.text: Generate video locally with LTX 2.3 or WAN, then upscale with SeedVR2.
On an M5 Max 128 GB, the SeedVR2 3B runner on MPS bf16 hit five bugs (three crashes, two silent numerical failures); fixes supplied.
The latest ComfyUI update broke the numz nodes; the maintainer advises ComfyUI's native SeedVR2 implementation.
On a 16 GB CUDA GPU, native 7B/3B int8 video upscaling 360p→1080p ran out of memory beyond ~3-second clips.
